slide.title: Technical design reads exact revisions
slide.takeaway: Overview → Technical design → one canonical page per exact revision, with intent, lifecycle and comparison newness as separate facts.

item.label: Technical design directories
item.description: Overview → Technical design lists Systems, Components, ERDs and data entities in directories that state intent, lifecycle, revision heads and use counts, never a score.

references.note: Builds one directory per kind with explicit intent, lifecycle, heads and Item-use counts; newness appears only when comparing.

criterion_links.rationale: The Technical design page is the overview entry point listing Systems, Components, ERDs and data entities.

item.label: Canonical page at an exact revision
item.description: A definition page renders the unique current revision, or the ?revision= pin with its stale, retired or conflicted status; competing heads are named and none is chosen.

references.note: Resolves the requested or unique current revision, lists every competing head, and reports the shown pin's status without substituting another.

criterion_links.rationale: The page presents the definition's description and code at the exact revision a reader asked for, with currency visible.

item.label: Intent, lifecycle and newness are separate
item.description: Intent is explicit or unspecified; newness is new, revised or unchanged only against a named comparison's merge-base, and unknown with its reason when that base cannot be read.

references.note: Loads the inventory at the comparison's merge-base through savedview; an unreadable base is unknown with its reason, never an empty inventory.

criterion_links.rationale: Newness is shown only relative to the named comparison, never as a badge on every proposal.
Directories and pages expose the same explicit intent for every kind, independent of code health.

item.label: Declared uses
item.description: A definition lists slide Items, owners such as System membership or ERD directories, and Items reaching it through one owner, each linking the exact slide Item or owner revision.

references.note: Turns each shared reverse-index use into a link to the exact slide Item, review Item or owner revision, naming any path through an owner.

criterion_links.rationale: The definition exposes the feature, deck, slide and Item that use it.
Following a use opens the referencing slide at the Item, not only the feature.

item.label: Reading is not repinning
item.description: Opening a saved revision reads it only: no slide pin changes, no review decision is recorded, and a link grants no coverage.
item.body: Reading a pin never repins it, approves a slide, or grants coverage.

references.note: A requested revision is read exactly; a missing one is not found rather than replaced by the latest.

criterion_links.rationale: A saved proposal revision stays readable as saved even after later revisions.
